svg.aria-label: The premium a foreign tax domicile pays
svg.text: The premium a foreign tax domicile pays
Median price per square metre by the buyer's tax domicile, Q4 2025. Index, not euros.
An index: 100 is the median paid by buyers domiciled in Portugal. The release publishes the difference, not the two prices.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 7 September 2026
